args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's great that you have a personal site up and running! I noticed it's quite minimal at the moment — just a brief introduction and your email. I'd suggest adding more content, such as a section about who you are, your interests, projects, or skills. Adding some visuals, a photo, and maybe links to your social media or work would make it more engaging for visitors. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog is centered around your favorite hobby, hiking! It's a wonderful theme that can attract fellow outdoor enthusiasts. I'd suggest expanding it with more content — for example, blog posts about your favorite trails, hiking tips, gear reviews, or photos from your adventures. Adding categories or a way for readers to subscribe would also make it more engaging. Happy hiking, and keep writing!
